summary: This room is mostly synthesis-and-physics projects (delays, wavetables, string physics, quantum/photonic analogs) plus a few standalone concepts (State Machine, Wallpaper Groups). The connections already in place are dense within sub-families (Phoneme Choir/Talking Keyboard, Retrospective/Semantic/Slime Mold Delay, the wavetable-torus cluster) but there are real gaps crossing those sub-families: Piano String Inharmonicity never links to Portamento's guitar-bend tool even though they describe the identical tension-reduces-inharmonicity phenomenon, and never links to The Curve Is the Material even though that entry already calls Piano String Inharmonicity its "canonical instance" and directly answers Piano String's own open question about B as a real-time compositional parameter. Photonic Time Crystals and Quantum Synthesizer independently invoke vacuum-fluctuation amplification without ever meeting each other, and Photonic Time Crystals never meets Quantum Synthesizer's geometry-cousin Wallpaper Groups either, despite both hinging on "boundary conditions constrain a discrete mode spectrum." SMPTE LTC's own body calls timecode a "trickster convention" twice without linking the palace's Trickster entry that Retrospective Delay and Semantic Delay already treat as load-bearing — an easy, genuine, unforced link. Wavetable Space as Torus and The Curve Is the Material each carry several named sub-sections (Tonnetz, Berry Phase, Orbital Resonance, Quasicrystals, Spectroscopy, Phonon Dispersion) that never made it into frontmatter — not passing mentions but full headers, so they're real unsung paths, not clutter. On the "cluttered" question: the one clean subtraction is What Claim Does Scientific Sonification Make?, which is thin because it is, almost word for word, an elaboration of a Decision Point The Metaphor Stretch already names (Fidelity Claim) — it reads better as that entry's fourth case study than as its own seed. Nothing else in the room is thin enough or neighborless enough to compost or demote; the room is well-tended, just under-linked across its sub-families.

typed_relations.label: guitar-bend-shared-artifact
typed_relations.evidence: "When you bend a piano string...tension increases...Inharmonicity decreases" (Piano String Inharmonicity) vs. Portamento's tool 6: "Guitar String Bend Physics — Finger bends a string; tension increases, inharmonicity decreases. See partials compress toward ideal harmonic positions."
typed_relations.rationale: Both entries independently describe and, in Portamento's case, already built an interactive tool for the exact same physical relationship (tension up → B down → partials compress). Neither entry links the other; this is a genuine shared-artifact gap, not a forced analogy.

typed_relations.label: answers-compositional-question
typed_relations.evidence: Piano String's open question: "Could inharmonicity be used as a compositional parameter? Varying B over time..." — The Curve Is the Material already answers this: "B is modulated at audio or LFO rate with one scalar... Real-time B modulation is maximally efficient."
typed_relations.rationale: The Curve Is the Material already links here labeled 'canonical-instance', but the reverse link is missing, and it would resolve a standing open question rather than merely gesture at it.

typed_relations.label: vacuum-fluctuation-as-audio-source
typed_relations.evidence: Photonic Time Crystals: "Amplification from vacuum noise. Bandgap-frequency light grows exponentially from any seed, including the quantum vacuum... turns vacuum fluctuations into measurable signals." Quantum Synthesizer: "the vacuum is not empty; it is full of zero-point fluctuations."
typed_relations.rationale: Two entries in different folders both ground an audio claim in vacuum fluctuations as a physically real phenomenon, neither aware of the other. Genuine cross-domain pattern the folder structure hides.

typed_relations.label: geometry-constrains-spectrum
typed_relations.evidence: Photonic Time Crystals: "ranges of frequencies that propagate freely...interspersed with ranges that don't" (band structure from periodicity) vs. Wallpaper Groups' crystallographic restriction theorem and 230 space groups governing crystal mode structure.
typed_relations.rationale: Both are cases of the same underlying claim — periodic boundary conditions produce a discrete, finite, enumerable mode/band spectrum — approached from optics and from tiling respectively. Both already point to Hyperdimensional Prism as the shared parent but never to each other.

typed_relations.label: physics-grounding-for-photonic-function-family
typed_relations.evidence: The Curve Is the Material lists "Photonic / crystal modes: Dispersion relation from crystal band structure... Already derived for the crystal synthesis project" as one of its named function families, but only names 'the crystal synthesis project' generically.
typed_relations.rationale: Photonic Time Crystals is the deep-physics grounding this function-family entry gestures at without naming — a direct, addressable gap.

typed_relations.label: engineering-trickster
typed_relations.evidence: "Timecode is a trickster convention: it pretends to measure absolute time but is in fact a counter." / "Drop-frame NTSC...a trickster convention in the spec itself."
typed_relations.rationale: The word 'trickster' appears twice in the body, unlinked, while two other room members (Retrospective Delay, Semantic Delay) already treat [[Trickster]] as a load-bearing entry — this is a verbatim unsung path, not an imposed reading.

typed_relations.label: interpolation-methods
typed_relations.evidence: Quadratic Interpolation's open question: "Cubic vs. quadratic in oscillators... is the extra cost justified?" vs. Wavetable Synthesis Research's design requirement: "at least cubic interpolation" and "linear is minimum viable, cubic...is better, windowed-sinc...is highest quality."
typed_relations.rationale: Wavetable Synthesis Research has effectively settled the open question Quadratic Interpolation in DSP is still asking, and this is also the room's one genuine opportunity to wire an inbound link to a 0-inbound newcomer.

typed_relations.label: signal-rate-vs-control-rate-tradeoff
typed_relations.evidence: Signal-Rate CV Architecture: "No control-rate parameters. Every input is a CV jack." Slime Mold Delay: "Topology engine (CPU, low-rate): runs at ~30 Hz... Audio engine (DSP rate): renders the graph."
typed_relations.rationale: Slime Mold Delay is a Biomechanical Synthesis instrument — exactly the family Signal-Rate CV Architecture's own open question asks whether its principle should govern — and it deliberately answers with a hybrid low-rate/signal-rate split for CPU reasons. A real, evidenced counterexample, not a forced opposition.

typed_relations.label: thinking-vs-remembering

typed_relations.rationale: Reciprocal link — Slime Mold Delay is a 0-inbound newcomer; Retrospective Delay already names the relationship but doesn't record it.

typed_relations.rationale: Same reciprocal-link case as above — closes a second inbound gap for the newcomer Slime Mold Delay.

synthesis_spawn_flag.unnamed_idea: The 'this is not a metaphor, it's the same operator/structure' claim — a recurring rhetorical move made explicitly and confidently across several entries (Reverb ↔ Space-Time: 'This isn't metaphor—it's physics'; Wavetable Space as Torus: 'This is not a metaphor. The topology...is exactly T²'; Photonic Time Crystals: 'The audio analog is not a metaphor; it is the same operator in a different domain') — without a shared named treatment of when such a claim is earned versus when it collapses into loose analogy.
synthesis_spawn_flag.why_load_bearing: What Claim Does Scientific Sonification Make? already interrogates exactly this question but only from the Crystal Synthesizer's angle (discrete-partial rendering of a continuous DOS). The same epistemic question — what work is 'not a metaphor' actually doing — is being asserted, unexamined, by at least three other entries in this room alone. It's load-bearing because several entries' central claims rest on it holding.
